title: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp
lede: Chrome DevTools for agents is an MCP server and CLI that let coding agents control a live Chrome browser and use DevTools to debug pages and analyse performance.

points: Records performance traces and extracts insights from them, optionally alongside CrUX real-user data.
Inspects network requests, screenshots and console messages with source-mapped stack traces.
Automates the browser through Puppeteer and waits for each action to finish.
Bundles skills for accessibility, cookie, LCP and memory-leak debugging, installable as an agent plugin.
Usage statistics are collected by default; a flag or the CI variable turns them off.

points.text: The most-discussed request is a tool to pick an element on the page and inspect it.
Chrome can hang or crash when the server attaches to a browser with many tabs open.
Users want several sessions or Chrome instances running at once.
Logpoints, to capture runtime values without editing source.
